versions.changelog:
Initial release of huawei-cloud-waf-policy-manage: Import WAF protection policies from JSON for migration and batch deployment.

- Supports importing protection policies from JSON exported by huawei-cloud-waf-policy-query
- Enables creation of new policies or overwriting of existing ones
- Resolves CLI parameter conflicts with --cli-jsonInput option
- Guides through fixed initial prerequisite checks and parameter collection
- Handles policy resources, batch rule creation (11 types), and sequential workflow as per strict execution requirements
